However, she does not particularly enjoy underhanded methods, and apparently her motto is “fair and square espionage activities.” She also describes herself as heartless, but according to those who knew her during her student years, she unexpectedly had an emotional side to her.

Toward her daughter Claudia, she educates her strictly so that Claudia may become her successor. At the same time, she deeply loves her daughter, though she is unable to express those feelings very well. Even so, the bond between parent and child is strong, and their relationship itself is a good one.

From the very beginning, she holds a strong interest in the protagonist, and intends to bring him into her class no matter what. A savior from another world is a precious existence, and she seems willing to use every possible means for that purpose. She has absolutely no hesitation in using her own body for it, and rather seems to enjoy doing so.
